title: Evidence record
description: The committed proof that one docs claim was tested: what ran, on what, where, what came back, and who approved recording it. One file per claim, testable-claims/pr-<docs_pr>/<claim_id>.json, grouped by the docs PR whose claims were tested; the configs, documents, and responses it cites sit beside it in files/. Read by codetests/evidence.py, which puts each record in TEST-MATRIX.md and can load every record into SQLite (evidence.SQLITE_TABLES). Kept flat on purpose so that load stays mechanical: a record is one claims row, each run one runs row, each checked field one run_fields row, and every object has a stable key.

schema_version.description: Bump when a field changes meaning, so a database loader can migrate old rows

claim_id.description: Unique across the repo, in the same namespace as code test IDs: the primary key, and the ID the page's tested-claims comment lists

docs_pr.description: The sensible-hq/sensible-docs PR whose claims were tested; names the record's folder, pr-<docs_pr>

page.description: The docs page, repo-relative, for example docs/Senseml reference/preprocessors/ocr-preprocessor.md

section.description: The heading of the section whose tested-claims comment lists this claim, without the # marks

claim.description: The claim as tested, quoted from the page at the time. Quoted rather than a line number, which drifts

verdict.description: holds_with_bug: the claim holds, but the test found an engine bug next to it (see bug)

link.description: The issue or message, once reported

page_change.description: What changed on the page because of this evidence, usually for a contradicted claim

approval.description: Who approved recording this claim, after the extract-testable-claims review step. A draft has no record file yet, so this is always present

file.description: A file beside the record, so the run can be recreated. The hash ties the record to the exact bytes, and lets a database share one row per file across claims

run_id.description: Unique within the record; with claim_id, the runs table's key

role.description: invalid: a run kept for the record that didn't test the claim, with why in purpose

purpose.description: What this run shows, and for a control, what it rules out

account.description: docs_test is SENSIBLE_TEST_API_KEY's account, the one doc tests use. personal marks runs made before that rule, kept as what actually ran

commit.description: The deployed engine commit, when known

note.description: What was deployed, for example which parameter name it accepted

fields.description: The fields this run checks. expected and actual are any JSON value; a database stores them as JSON text
